bahrain.title: Firms told to prepare now for 10 per cent corporate tax and e-invoicing
bahrain.summary: Tax advisers at Grant Thornton Bahrain say companies should clean up billing data and upgrade ERP systems now. The draft law, targeted for fiscal years from 1 January 2027, sets a 10 per cent tax on net profits above BD 200,000 or BD 1 million in annual revenue. E-invoicing dates are still awaited from the NBR.

bahrain.title: King Hamad opens the new parliamentary session today
bahrain.summary: His Majesty King Hamad opens the fifth session of the sixth legislative term this afternoon with a Royal Address. The Shura Council then elects its two deputy chairmen, and Parliament elects a first deputy speaker and committee heads, with around five MPs said to be in the running for the deputy speaker post.

bahrain.title: Shura member urges flexible AI law as government asks for a rethink
bahrain.summary: MPs are due to debate a proposed AI law later this month that would create a specialised AI unit, a compensation route for people harmed, and fines and criminal penalties. The government wants it reconsidered and suggests starting with a regulatory sandbox. Sponsor Ali Al Shehabi says the text should be made more adaptable.

bahrain.title: Ministry tenders multi-storey factories project in Salman Industrial City
bahrain.summary: The Industry and Commerce Ministry is seeking a developer to build, manage and lease a multi-storey factory building for SMEs on a 6,700 square metre plot in Hidd, with about 10,720 square metres of built-up space. The winner will lease the land from the ministry. Bids close on 23 December 2026 through the Tender Board portal.

bahrain.title: First Made in GCC forum ends with a run of industrial deals
bahrain.summary: The three-day exhibition at Exhibition World Bahrain drew more than 10,500 visitors and over 120 companies. Agreements and expansions were announced in energy storage, aluminium, food production, automotive components and logistics. Industry Minister Abdulla bin Adel Fakhro urged the private sector to lead cross-border investment.

bahrain.title: BisB sets aside USD 32 million in financing for manufacturers and SMEs
bahrain.summary: Bahrain Islamic Bank launched Sharia compliant packages worth USD 32 million for manufacturers, SMEs and companies in Bahrain, covering solar projects, lower emission technology, supply chains and liquidity. It also signed an MoU with the Industry and Commerce Ministry to raise awareness of financing options. Eligibility criteria apply.

bahrain.title: Two customs officers on trial over BD 5,000 bribe from drug ring
bahrain.summary: Two Bahraini airport customs officers, aged 25 and 34, are accused of taking BD 5,000 to let marijuana through, and are on trial with 11 Indian defendants linked to a network run from India. Both are said to have admitted taking bribes. They are already serving five years each for robbing a passenger of BD 350.

bahrain.title: Councillor wants two independent valuations before impounded cars are auctioned
bahrain.summary: Northern Municipal Council vice-chairwoman Zaina Jassim wants each abandoned or confiscated vehicle valued twice before sale so owners can trust the price. The municipality says vehicles are valued individually at market price and sold through Mazad, and that removal and storage charges are fixed. It says it does not keep the proceeds.

crypto.title: US CFTC moves to class prediction market contracts as swaps
crypto.summary: The CFTC issued an interim final rule keeping casino-style gambling outside its swaps definition and proposed a second rule placing event contracts on sports, politics, culture and weather under swaps regulation, with a 30-day comment period. The aim is to back its claim to sole authority over platforms like Kalshi against state challenges.

crypto.title: US bitcoin and ether ETFs lose nearly $1 billion so far in October
crypto.summary: Farside data shows bitcoin ETFs shed $244.1 million on Thursday after $484.9 million on Wednesday, the largest daily outflow since 25 June. Ether ETFs fell for an eighth straight session, losing about $641.3 million over the streak. Combined October outflows reached $986.3 million as bitcoin dipped to $80,427.

crypto.title: French finance committee backs taxing crypto swaps into stablecoins from 2027
crypto.summary: The National Assembly's Finance Committee adopted amendments making conversions into fiat-pegged stablecoins taxable from 1 January 2027, letting realised crypto losses be carried forward 10 years, and applying exit tax to households with over 800,000 euros in crypto that move abroad. The full Assembly starts examining the bill on 13 October.

crypto.title: New York secures up to $35 million and a lifetime ban from Celsius founder Mashinsky
crypto.summary: Attorney General Letitia James settled her 2023 civil case against Alex Mashinsky, who is serving 12 years for fraud. He is permanently barred from the securities, commodities and crypto industries and must pay $25 million if he does not forfeit $10 million federally, plus $10 million more if he does not serve his full sentence.

crypto.title: DWF Labs units sue BitGo in London over alleged early token sales
crypto.summary: DWF Maas and Falcon Digital say BitGo sold discounted FF and ESPORTS tokens before a three-month lock-up ended, pushing prices down, the Financial Times reported. They are seeking damages reported as $114 million in the High Court. Neither side responded to CoinDesk's request for comment.

crypto.title: Solana set to cut block time to 200 milliseconds, half the level in August
crypto.summary: The final step in a seven-week series of cuts from 400 milliseconds was scheduled for Friday at epoch 1053, giving five block slots per second. Each block's computing limit drops to 30 million units, so capacity stays roughly the same. Validators face higher voting costs and transactions get a shorter validity window.
